different_assay_examples.from: Nucleotide fitness scores of TEM-1 β-lactamase
Amino acid fitness scores of TEM-1 β-lactamase

rule: two deposits of one MaveDB experiment are one assay
two deposits whose score set titles agree once the target name is removed are one assay
anything else is counted as a different assay, and a pair whose title is empty after the removal is undetermined
